title: Clícalo performance budgets
description: The performance budgets of blueprint §10.3 that a measurement of tests/Clicalo.Performance enforces (NFR-001). Each budget names its statistic, its limit (exactly one value kind), where it fails the run and its requirement or source.

description.description: English sentence: what is measured, from which event to which event.

statistic.description: How the sample is reduced before it is compared with the limit (nearest-rank percentiles).

minSamples.description: The fewest values the statistic may be computed from; a smaller sample fails the measurement.

gate.description: everyRun: the budget fails every continuous-integration run that measures it (hosted runners and the touch laboratory). touchLab: it fails only on the touch laboratory (CLICALO_PERF_GATE=1) and is a trend elsewhere.

source.description: Blueprint section that sets the number.
